# George Nijo

> Software engineer in Boston building infrastructure for AI agents: coordination meshes, MCP brokers, and control planes. Currently building AgentOS, a personal + home agent operating system. Local-first, honesty-first.

This site is a terminal-styled single-page app. Every page below has a markdown variant served from the same path with a `.md` extension. Markdown is also available via content negotiation where the origin supports it (`Accept: text/markdown`, responses carry `Vary: Accept`).

## When to use this site

- You need background on George Nijo (employment, projects, contact) — read [About](https://georgenijo.com/about.md) and [Home](https://georgenijo.com/index.md).
- You are evaluating or integrating his agent-infrastructure tools — read [Projects](https://georgenijo.com/projects.md), then go to the linked GitHub repos for docs and source.
- You want current activity — read [Now](https://georgenijo.com/now.md) and [Burn log](https://georgenijo.com/burn.md).
- To reach George, use [Contact](https://georgenijo.com/contact.md); GitHub issues on a project repo get the fastest response.

This is a personal portfolio, not a product API: there is nothing to call programmatically except the JSON snapshots listed below.

## Pages

- [Home](https://georgenijo.com/index.md): who George is, what he builds, and how to reach him.
- [About](https://georgenijo.com/about.md): background, principles, and languages (Python, Go, Rust, Swift).
- [Projects](https://georgenijo.com/projects.md): nine repos across five languages — agent-mesh, usher, hangar, ghosthands, murmur-app, fleetmap, gauge, whoop-dashboard, aperture.
- [Now](https://georgenijo.com/now.md): current focus — AgentOS, hangar, usher, agent-mesh.
- [Burn log](https://georgenijo.com/burn.md): tokens, models, and commits over the last 30 days.
- [Contact](https://georgenijo.com/contact.md): email, GitHub, LinkedIn.

## Machine-readable files

- [Sitemap](https://georgenijo.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of all pages.
- [Lab events spec](https://georgenijo.com/docs/george-lab-events.md): repository-dispatch event contract driving George Lab.
- [Lab projects snapshot](https://georgenijo.com/data/lab-projects.json): project telemetry (schema version 1).
- [Fleet health snapshot](https://georgenijo.com/data/fleet-health.json): short-lived privacy-safe collector snapshot.
